source: Verified research, Goose 1.60 ([Goose] rows of the Zed/Aider/Goose/Droid/Auggie/Junie entry): goose repo documentation/docs/guides/context-engineering/hooks.md, Open Plugins hooks spec (skeptic: hook_pre_tool and hook_session_start corrected, hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: The verified research names no Goose hook env var, so Goose is picked by --agent goose or CI_AGENT.
selection.bareNote: Goose names the event in `event`, not hook_event_name, so with no flag the deny is exit 2 with the reason on stderr, which Goose documents as a block.

deny.source: [Goose] hook_pre_tool: block with exit 2 (reason on stderr); stdout is the decision channel, so nothing else is printed.

context.source: [Goose] hook_session_start (skeptic): SessionStart is observation-only; lessons go through GOOSE_MOIM_MESSAGE_FILE (plan PR 11).

PreToolUse.source: Goose hook_payload_example: the documented PostToolUse stdin with the event set to PreToolUse; the skeptic adds tool_call_id

PostToolUse.source: Goose hook_payload_example: PostToolUse stdin verbatim from hooks.md (values replaced)

UserPromptSubmit.source: [Goose] hook_user_prompt: UserPromptSubmit is observation-only and the prompt arrives in message

SessionStart.source: [Goose] hook_session_start: the SessionStart event fires, observation-only; its keys beyond event, session_id and working_dir are not documented

Stop.source: [Goose] hook_stop: a Stop block forces the turn to continue; the payload includes last_assistant_message

absent.SessionEnd: No SessionEnd event in the [Goose] rows of the verified research, so session.mjs is not wired to one.
